title: Exploration of Flavonoids as Lead Compounds against Ewing Sarcoma through Molecular Docking, Pharmacogenomics Analysis, and Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
authors: Yasir, Muhammad; Park, Jinyoung; Han, Eun-Taek; Park, Won Sun; Han, Jin-Hee; Kwon, Yong-Soo; Lee, Hee-Jae; Hassan, Mubashir; Kloczkowski, Andrzej; Chun, Wanjoo
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟探索黄酮类化合物靶向EWS/FLI融合蛋白的RNA结合基序，虽涉及转录因子相关蛋白和物理模拟方法，但核心是药物-蛋白相互作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与课题关联度较低。
abstract: Ewing sarcoma (ES) is a highly malignant carcinoma prevalent in children and most frequent in the second decade of life. It mostly occurs due to t(11;22) (q24;q12) translocation. This translocation encodes the oncogenic fusion protein EWS/FLI (Friend leukemia integration 1 transcription factor), which acts as an aberrant transcription factor to deregulate target genes essential for cancer. Traditionally, flavonoids from plants have been investigated against viral and cancerous diseases and have shown some promising results to combat these disorders. In the current study, representative flavonoid compounds from various subclasses are selected and used to disrupt the RNA-binding motif of EWS, which is required for EWS/FLI fusion. By blocking the RNA-binding motif of EWS, it might be possible to combat ES. Therefore, molecular docking experiments validated the binding interaction patterns and structural behaviors of screened flavonoid compounds within the active region of the Ewing sarcoma protein (EWS). Furthermore, pharmacogenomics analysis was used to investigate potential drug interactions with Ewing sarcoma-associated genes. Finally, molecular dynamics simulations were used to investigate the stability of the best selected docked complexes. Taken together, daidzein, kaempferol, and genistein exhibited a result comparable to ifosfamide in the proposed in silico study and can be further analyzed as possible candidate compounds in biological in vitro studies against ES.
abstract_zh: 尤文肉瘤（Ewing sarcoma, ES）是一种高度恶性的肿瘤，常见于儿童，且在第二个十年生命阶段最为多发。其发生主要与t(11;22) (q24;q12) 易位相关。该易位编码致癌融合蛋白EWS/FLI（Friend白血病整合1转录因子），该蛋白作为异常转录因子，失调对癌症至关重要的靶基因。传统上，植物来源的黄酮类化合物已被研究用于抗病毒和抗癌疾病，并显示出对抗这些疾病的一些有前景的结果。在本研究中，选取了不同亚类的代表性黄酮类化合物，用于破坏EWS的RNA结合基序，该基序是EWS/FLI融合所必需的。通过阻断EWS的RNA结合基序，可能有助于对抗ES。因此，分子对接实验验证了筛选出的黄酮类化合物在尤文肉瘤蛋白（EWS）活性区域内的结合相互作用模式和结构行为。此外，采用药物基因组学分析来研究潜在药物与尤文肉瘤相关基因的相互作用。最后，利用分子动力学模拟来评估最佳选定对接复合物的稳定性。综合而言，黄豆苷元、山柰酚和染料木黄酮在所提出的计算机模拟研究中表现出与异环磷酰胺相当的结果，并可作为候选化合物在针对ES的生物学体外研究中进一步分析。
